place.source_title: Henry G. & Frances Kleinfelter House, 312 North Pinckney Street

brief: Two-and-a-half-storey frame Queen Anne house of 1900 with a round corner tower under a conical roof, steep cross gables, clapboard walls and a wraparound porch on rock-faced stone piers; recorded before demolition with its windows boarded and the porch stripped, squeezed between apartment houses.

facade.notes: 312 N Pinckney St (Madison, 1900): a Queen Anne with a corner turret, cut into student rooms with an iron fire escape on the side, a porch on rock-faced stone piers, boarded windows; tight to neighbours near the Capitol

why.note: downtown Madison rooming houses recorded before demolition for new building
a house converted to a rooming house needs a second exit: the iron fire escape
